title: walk.rs parse_structure 'part_index parameter' in doc comment names wrong thing
description: walk.rs line 56: doc comment says 'The part_index parameter (i in the RFC) is the 0-based position...'. However the function signature has no parameter named part_index — i is the implicit loop variable from 'for (i, part) in parts.iter().enumerate()'. The doc comment should say 'The loop variable i (used implicitly via enumerate())' or remove the misleading parameter name.
